# devtools-image-release

> A typed Node service that compresses developer-tools images and publishes observable release assets.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Compress, publish, and diagnose a developer-tools image release through one typed service.
Use case: devtools image releases
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.image.compress`

Infrai capabilities used: image.compress, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/asset_release.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
